description: 198.51.100.20 sends 20 DNS queries at TTL 50 (14 hops from 64), establishing its distance. Then 10 SYNs claiming its address arrive at TTL 120 (8 hops from 128): 6 hops off. The SYNs are held back until their handshakes end; none completes, so each counts when it times out (3 s): the 5th fires ttl_anomaly and the next 5 are summarized. By then the spoofed distance has 10 samples and is listed as established too.
